verses.sloka: सेनापतीन् पञ्च स तु प्रमापितान् हनूमता सानुचरान् सवाहनान् ।समीक्ष्य राजा समरोद्धतोन्मुखं कुमारमक्षं प्रसमैक्षताग्रतः ।। ५.४७.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: senāpatīn pañca sa tu pramāpitān hanūmatā sānucarān savāhanān ।samīkṣya rājā samaroddhatonmukhaṁ kumāramakṣaṁ prasamaikṣatāgrataḥ ।। 5.47.1।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the sad news of death of the five army generals including their followers and destruction of their vehicles, King (Ravana) gave a suggestive look at prince Aksha who was inclined to fight the war.
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्ड का पचासवां सग पुरा हुआ । — मे (>> एकपञ्चाशः सगः तं समीक्ष्य महासत्त्वं सत्ववान्हरिसत्तमः । वाक्यमर्थवदव्यग्रस्तमुवाच दशाननम्‌

verses.sloka: स तस्य दृष्ट्यर्पणसंप्रचोदितः प्रतापवान् काञ्चनचित्रकार्मुकः ।समुत्पपाताथ सदस्युदीरितो द्विजातिमुख्यैर्हविषेव पावकः ।। ५.४७.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya dṛṣṭyarpaṇasaṁpracoditaḥ pratāpavān kāñcanacitrakārmukaḥ ।samutpapātātha sadasyudīrito dvijātimukhyairhaviṣeva pāvakaḥ ।। 5.47.2।।।।

translations.english: Spurred by the mere glance of Ravana, the glorious Aksha with his wonderful bow inlaid with gold sprang up from the royal assembly just as flame rises from firesanctuary when oblations are poured in by reputed brahmins.
translations.hindi: में सुग्रीव की प्राज्ञा से यहां तुम्हारी फ्री में श्राया हैं । है राक्षसराज !! वानरराज सुग्रीव ने भाईचारे के विचार से तुमको खुशीराजी कही है

verses.sloka: ततो महद्बालदिवाकरप्रभं प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालसंततम् ।रतं समास्थाय ययौ स वीर्यवान् महाहरिं तं प्रति नैर्ऋतर्षभः ।। ५.४७.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato mahadbāladivākaraprabhaṁ prataptajāmbūnadajālasaṁtatam ।rataṁ samāsthāya yayau sa vīryavān mahāhariṁ taṁ prati nairṛtarṣabhaḥ ।। 5.47.3।।।।

translations.english: Ascending a glittering chariot inlaid with pure gold Aksha, the courageous bull among giants looking splendid like the rising Sun, marched forth towards the great vanara.
translations.hindi: भाई महात्मा सुग्रीव का सन्देसा सुनो । उनका सन्देसा घ॒र्मं और ग्रथ से युक्त होने के कारण इस लोक ग्रौर परलोक दोनों के लिए हितकारी है

verses.sloka: तपस्सङ्ग्रहसञ्चयार्जितं तपोनुष्ठनसमूहसम्पादितम् ।। ५.४७.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tapassaṅgrahasañcayārjitaṁ taponuṣṭhanasamūhasampāditam ।। 5.47.4।।।।

translations.english: The chariot was (strong as it was) gained by his austerities of high order. It was overlaid with pure gold armour, fixed with flags, and staff, studded with precious gems, yoked to the best of eight horses and endowed with the speed of mind.
translations.hindi: भ्रनेक रथों, हाथियों ग्रौर घोड़ों के ग्रधिपति श्रौर इन्द्र की तरह द्युतिमान्‌ महाराज दशरथ श्रपनी प्रजा के वसे ही हितैषी थे जैसे पिता भ्रपने पुत्रों का हितैषी होता है

verses.sloka: सुरासुराधृष्यमसङ्गचारिणं रविप्रभं व्योमचरं समाहितम् ।सतूणमष्टासिनिबद्धबन्धुरं यथाक्रमावेशितशक्तितोमरम् ।। ५.४७.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: surāsurādhṛṣyamasaṅgacāriṇaṁ raviprabhaṁ vyomacaraṁ samāhitam ।satūṇamaṣṭāsinibaddhabandhuraṁ yathākramāveśitaśaktitomaram ।। 5.47.5।।।।

translations.english: (The chariot) was unassailable to suras or asuras.It moved without touching the ground, it could fly in air and had the splendour of the Sun. It was equipped readily with quivers, eight swords, javelins and clubs placed in right order.

verses.sloka: विराजमानं प्रतिपूर्णवस्तुना सहेमदाम्ना शशिसूर्यवर्चसा ।दिवाकराभं रथमास्थितस्ततः स निर्जगामामरतुल्यविक्रमः ।। ५.४७.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: virājamānaṁ pratipūrṇavastunā sahemadāmnā śaśisūryavarcasā ।divākarābhaṁ rathamāsthitastataḥ sa nirjagāmāmaratulyavikramaḥ ।। 5.47.6।।।।

translations.english: Prince Aksha, whose courage was equal to that of gods, shone like the Sun. He ascended the splendid chariot decked with golden garlands shining like Sun and Moon, equipped with all weapons, bows and shields etc, he went out.
translations.hindi: उनके साथ उनके भाई लक्ष्मण श्रौर उनकी स्त्री सीता भी बन में आई ॥ राजा श्रीरामचन्द्रजी महातेजस्वी भ्रौर धमंपथारूढ हैं

verses.sloka: स पूरयन् खं च महीं च साचलां तुरङ्गमातङ्गमहारथस्वनैः ।बलैः समेतैः स हि तोरणस्थितं समर्थमासीनमुपागमत् कपिम् ।। ५.४७.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa pūrayan khaṁ ca mahīṁ ca sācalāṁ turaṅgamātaṅgamahārathasvanaiḥ ।balaiḥ sametaiḥ sa hi toraṇasthitaṁ samarthamāsīnamupāgamat kapim ।। 5.47.7।।।।

translations.english: Seated on the chariot he (Aksha) sallied forth along with the army filling the entire earth and mountains with the sounds of horses, elephants and rumblings of big chariots and reached the portal where the great vanara stood.
translations.hindi: तस्य भार्या वने नष्टा सीता पतिसनुव्रता । वेदेहस्य सुता राज्ञो जनकस्य महात्मनः ६४७१६ उनकी पतिब्रता भार्या सीता को, जो महात्मा राजा विदेह जनक की चेटी है, वन में किसी ने हर लिया

verses.sloka: स तं समासाद्य हरिं हरीक्षणो युगान्तकालाग्निमिव प्रजाक्षये ।अवस्थितं विस्मितजातसंभ्रमः समैक्षताक्षो बहुमानचक्षुषा ।। ५.४७.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ samāsādya hariṁ harīkṣaṇo yugāntakālāgnimiva prajākṣaye ।avasthitaṁ vismitajātasaṁbhramaḥ samaikṣatākṣo bahumānacakṣuṣā ।। 5.47.8।।।।

translations.english: The lioneyed Aksha saw the vanara who appeared like the cosmic fire at the time of dissolution of the universe. The prince was astonished and struck with awe (at the majestic form of the Vanara) and looked at him with great respect.

verses.sloka: स तस्य वेगं च कपेर्महात्मनः पराक्रमं चारिषु पार्थिवात्मजः ।विधारयन् स्वं च बलं महाबलो हिमक्षये सूर्य इवाभिवर्धते ।। ५.४७.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya vegaṁ ca kapermahātmanaḥ parākramaṁ cāriṣu pārthivātmajaḥ ।vidhārayan svaṁ ca balaṁ mahābalo himakṣaye sūrya ivābhivardhate ।। 5.47.9।।।।

translations.english: Aksha, the mighty prince judging the speed and prowess of the monkey with his own in confronting enemies and the strength of the monkey, began to swell up in spirit like the glow of the Sun at the end of winter.

verses.sloka: स जातमन्युः प्रसमीक्ष्य विक्रमं स्थिरं स्थितः संयति दुर्निवारणम् ।समाहितात्मा हनुमन्तमाहवे प्रचोदयामास शरैस्त्रिभिः शितैः ।। ५.४७.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa jātamanyuḥ prasamīkṣya vikramaṁ sthiraṁ sthitaḥ saṁyati durnivāraṇam ।samāhitātmā hanumantamāhave pracodayāmāsa śaraistribhiḥ śitaiḥ ।। 5.47.10।।।।

translations.english: Knowing that it is difficult to win Hanuman who was steady and of irresistible valour Aksha was angry. Remaining steady, with full attention, he provoked the vanara to fight and released three sharp arrows.

verses.sloka: ततः कपिः तं प्रसमीभ्य गर्वितं जितश्रमं शत्रुपराजयोर्जितम् ।अवैक्षताक्षः समुदीर्णमानसः स बाणपाणिः प्रगृहीतकार्मुकः ।। ५.४७.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kapiḥ taṁ prasamībhya garvitaṁ jitaśramaṁ śatruparājayorjitam ।avaikṣatākṣaḥ samudīrṇamānasaḥ sa bāṇapāṇiḥ pragṛhītakārmukaḥ ।। 5.47.11।।।।

translations.english: Then Aksha contempuously looked at Hanuman who had conquered his fatigue and was determined to defeat the enemy. Holding in his hands his bow and arrows proudly, he reflected.
translations.hindi: त्वया विज्ञातपूर्वश्च वाली वानरपुङ्गवः । रासेण निहतः संख्ये शरेणैकेन वानरः

verses.sloka: स हेमनिष्काङ्गदचारुकुण्डलः समाससादाशुपराक्रमः कपिम् ।तयोर्बभूवाप्रतिमः समागमः सुरासुराणामपि सम्भ्रमप्रदः ।। ५.४७.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa hemaniṣkāṅgadacārukuṇḍalaḥ samāsasādāśuparākramaḥ kapim ।tayorbabhūvāpratimaḥ samāgamaḥ surāsurāṇāmapi sambhramapradaḥ ।। 5.47.12।।।।

translations.english: Adorned with armlets studded with golden coins and lovely earrings Aksha advanced instantaneously to meet the monkey. Their matchless combat excuitement and enthusiasm even among gods and demons.
translations.hindi: सत्यप्रतिज्ञ कपिराज सुग्रीव ने सीता का पता लगाने के लिए व्यत्र हो, समस्त दिश्ाम्नों में वानरो को भेजा । लाखों करोड़ों वानर सब दिशाभ्नों ही में नहीं वल्कि भ्राकाश पाताल में भी सीता का पता लगाने को घूम रहे हैं

verses.sloka: ररास भूमिर्न तताप भानुमान् ववौ न वायुः प्रचचाल चाचलः ।कपेः कुमारस्य च वीक्ष्य संयुगं ननाद च द्यौरुदधिश्च चुक्षुभे ।। ५.४७.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: rarāsa bhūmirna tatāpa bhānumān vavau na vāyuḥ pracacāla cācalaḥ ।kapeḥ kumārasya ca vīkṣya saṁyugaṁ nanāda ca dyaurudadhiśca cukṣubhe ।। 5.47.13।।।।

translations.english: Witnessing the fight between Hanuman and Prince Aksha, even the earth shrieked in agony, the Sun became dim, the wind stopped blowing, mountains were shaken, the sky thundered and even the ocean was agitated.

verses.sloka: ततः स वीरः सुमुखात् पतत्त्रिणः सुवर्णपुङ्खान् सविषानिवोरगान् ।समाधिसंयोगविमोक्षतत्त्वविच्छरानथ त्रीन् कपिमूर्ध्न्यपातयत् ।। ५.४७.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa vīraḥ sumukhāt patattriṇaḥ suvarṇapuṅkhān saviṣānivoragān ।samādhisaṁyogavimokṣatattvaviccharānatha trīn kapimūrdhnyapātayat ।। 5.47.14।।।।

translations.english: Heroic Aksha, who was good at targeting correctly, with due concentration struck the vanara on his head with three goldenshafted, winged arrows with feathers smeared with poison which resembled serpents.
translations.hindi: जो वानर सीता का पता लगाने को भेजे गए हैँ, उनमें बहुत से गरुड के समान और बहुत से पवन के समान हैं । वे महाबली वानर बेरोकटोक शीघ्रगामी हे

verses.sloka: स तैः शरैर्मूर्ध्नि समं निपातितैः क्षरन्नसृग्दिग्धविवृत्तलोचनः ।नवोदितादित्यनिभः शरांशुमान् व्यराजतादित्य इवांशुमालिकः ।। ५.४७.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taiḥ śarairmūrdhni samaṁ nipātitaiḥ kṣarannasṛgdigdhavivṛttalocanaḥ ।navoditādityanibhaḥ śarāṁśumān vyarājatāditya ivāṁśumālikaḥ ।। 5.47.15।।।।

translations.english: With the three arrows shot on his forehead simultaneously his eyes were drenched with flowing blood and with arrows shining like rays he appeared like the rising Sun, garlanded by glowing rays.
translations.hindi: में पवनदेव का श्रौरस पुत्र हूं श्रौर मेरा नाम हनुमान है । में सीता की खोज में तुरन्त सौ योजन समुद्र को लाघ उसको (सीता को ) देखने के लिए यहाँ श्राया हूँ । लक्षा में घूमते फिरते, मुझे तुम्हारे घर में सीता देख पडी है

verses.sloka: ततः स पिङ्गाधिपमन्त्रसत्तमः समीक्ष्य तं राजवरात्मजं रणे ।उदग्रचित्रायुधचित्रकार्मुकं जहर्ष चापूर्यत चाहवोन्मुखः ।। ५.४७.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa piṅgādhipamantrasattamaḥ samīkṣya taṁ rājavarātmajaṁ raṇe ।udagracitrāyudhacitrakārmukaṁ jaharṣa cāpūryata cāhavonmukhaḥ ।। 5.47.16।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the esteemed minister of the copperyeyed Sugriva observed the prince holding manifold splendid weapons. He rejoiced, grew in size ready to fight, making the necessary prepararions (taking the required position).
translations.hindi: देखिए, देवताग्रों श्रथवा भसुरों में ऐसा कौन है जो लक्ष्मण के छोड़े हुए प्रौर क्रुद्ध हुए श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के फेके हुए, बाणों के सामने टिक सके

verses.sloka: स मन्दराग्रस्थ इवांशुमालिको विवृद्धकोपो बलवीर्यसंयुतः ।कुमारमक्षं सबलं सवाहनं ददाह नेत्राग्निमरीचिभिस्तदा ।। ५.४७.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa mandarāgrastha ivāṁśumāliko vivṛddhakopo balavīryasaṁyutaḥ ।kumāramakṣaṁ sabalaṁ savāhanaṁ dadāha netrāgnimarīcibhistadā ।। 5.47.17।।।।

translations.english: Huge Hanuman, endowed with strength and valour looked like the rising Sun on the peak of mount Mandara. He looked at prince Aksha and his army as well as his vehicles as though he was burning them with the rays emerging from his fiery eyes.
translations.hindi: हे महाप्राज्ञ ! तुम धर्म श्रोर श्रथं को मली भांति जानते हो, थोर तपःप्रभाव से तुमने यह ऐइयवं सम्पादन किया है । श्रतः तुमको पराई स्त्री को अपने घर में बंद कर रखना उचित नहीं

verses.sloka: ततः स बाणासनचित्रकार्मुकः शरप्रवर्षो युधि राक्षसाम्बुदः ।शरान् मुमोचाशु हरीश्वराचले वलाहको वृष्टिमिवाचलोत्तमे ।। ५.४७.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bāṇāsanacitrakārmukaḥ śarapravarṣo yudhi rākṣasāmbudaḥ ।śarān mumocāśu harīśvarācale valāhako vṛṣṭimivācalottame ।। 5.47.18।।।।

translations.english: Aksha, with his wonderful quiver and bow, began to rain rapidly a shower of arrows in the battle, on the mountainlike monkeylord just as a cloud rains on a mountain.

verses.sloka: ततः कपिस्तं रणचण्डविक्रमं विवृद्धतेजोबलवीर्यसंयुतम् ।कुमारमक्षं प्रसमीक्ष्य संयुगे ननाद हर्षाद्घनतुल्यविक्रमः ।। ५.४७.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kapistaṁ raṇacaṇḍavikramaṁ vivṛddhatejobalavīryasaṁyutam ।kumāramakṣaṁ prasamīkṣya saṁyuge nanāda harṣādghanatulyavikramaḥ ।। 5.47.19।।।।

translations.english: Then Hanuman saw prince Aksha, endowed with excessive splendour, power and energy advancing in a fierce manner like a cloud in the battle. Then Hanuman happy (to see the heroic prince) roared like a clap of thunder.

verses.sloka: स बालभावाद्युधि वीर्यदर्पितः प्रवृद्धमन्युः क्षतजोपमेक्षणः ।समाससादाप्रतिमं कपिं रणे गजो महाकूपमिवावृतं तृणैः ।। ५.४७.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa bālabhāvādyudhi vīryadarpitaḥ pravṛddhamanyuḥ kṣatajopamekṣaṇaḥ ।samāsasādāpratimaṁ kapiṁ raṇe gajo mahākūpamivāvṛtaṁ tṛṇaiḥ ।। 5.47.20।।।।

translations.english: Young Aksha, proud of his valour with eyes bloodshot in anger rushed towards the matchless Hanuman, just as an elephant would approach a huge pitfall covered with grass.
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! तीनों लोकों में एसा कोई पुरुष नहीं है, जो श्रीरामचन्द्र के साथ बिगाड़ कर, सुखी रह सके

verses.sloka: स तेन बाणैः प्रसभं निपातितैश्कार नादं घननादनिस्वनः ।समुत्पपाताशु नभः स मारुतिर्भुजोरुविक्षेपणघोरदर्शनः ।। ५.४७.२१।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tena bāṇaiḥ prasabhaṁ nipātitaiśkāra nādaṁ ghananādanisvanaḥ ।samutpapātāśu nabhaḥ sa mārutirbhujoruvikṣepaṇaghoradarśanaḥ ।। 5.47.21।।।।

translations.english: Struck by the arrows released by prince Aksha, Hanuman roared violently like a thundering cloud and leaped into the sky putting up a fierce appearance, stretching his arms and thighs.

verses.sloka: समुत्पतन्तं समभिद्रवद्बली स राक्षसानां प्रवरः प्रतापवान् ।रथी रथिश्रेष्ठतमः किरन् शरैः पयोधरः शैलमिवाश्मवृष्टिभिः ।। ५.४७.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: samutpatantaṁ samabhidravadbalī sa rākṣasānāṁ pravaraḥ pratāpavān ।rathī rathiśreṣṭhatamaḥ kiran śaraiḥ payodharaḥ śailamivāśmavṛṣṭibhiḥ ।। 5.47.22।।।।

translations.english: That mighty, valiant chief of the demons, foremost of chariot-warriors, chased the leaping Hanuman, raining arrows like a cloud showering hail upon a mountain.
translations.hindi: आर मैने तो सीता को देख ही लिया। मुझे तो दुर्लभ वस्तु का लाभ हो चुका । अब रहा इसके आगे का कत्तंव्य अर्थात्‌ जानकीजी का ले जाना सो श्रीरामचन्द्रजी जाने

verses.sloka: स तान् शरांस्तस्य हरिर्विमोक्षयंश्चचार वीरः पथि वायुसेविते ।शरान्तरे मारुतवद्विनिष्पतन् मनोजवः संयति चण्डविक्रमः ।। ५.४७.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tān śarāṁstasya harirvimokṣayaṁścacāra vīraḥ pathi vāyusevite ।śarāntare mārutavadviniṣpatan manojavaḥ saṁyati caṇḍavikramaḥ ।। 5.47.23।।।।

translations.english: Dodging like the wind between the arrows and also escaping the arrows Hanuman, who was swift in movement like the mind, was seen exhibiting his terrific valour in the battle while he moved in the sky.
translations.hindi: जिस सीता को तुमने अपने घर में बंद कर रखा है, उसे मैंने यहाँ बहुत दुःखी पाया है, सो यह मत समझना कि यह तुम्हारे वश में हो गई । किंतु इसे तुम पांच फनों वाली साँपिन की तरह अपना काल जानना

verses.sloka: तमात्तबाणासनमाहवोन्मुखं खमास्तृणन्तं विशिखैः शरोत्तमैः ।अवैक्षताक्षं बहुमानचक्षुषा जगाम चिन्तां च स मारुतात्मजः ।। ५.४७.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamāttabāṇāsanamāhavonmukhaṁ khamāstṛṇantaṁ viśikhaiḥ śarottamaiḥ ।avaikṣatākṣaṁ bahumānacakṣuṣā jagāma cintāṁ ca sa mārutātmajaḥ ।। 5.47.24।।।।

translations.english: Admiring the young Aksha's appearance, his skill in holding the quiver and spreading the excellent arrows with missiles and facing the war, Hanuman became thoughtful (as to how to kill him).
translations.hindi: क्या दैत्य भौर क्या देवता, कोई भी ऐसा नहीं जो इसे पचा जाय, जैसे विष मिले भ्रन्न फो पचाने की शक्ति किसी में नहीं होती

verses.sloka: ततः शरैर्भिन्नभुजान्तरः कपिः कुमारवीरेण महात्मना नदन् ।महाभुजः कर्मविशेषतत्त्वविद्विचिन्तयामास रणे पराक्रमम् ।। ५.४७.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śarairbhinnabhujāntaraḥ kapiḥ kumāravīreṇa mahātmanā nadan ।mahābhujaḥ karmaviśeṣatattvavidvicintayāmāsa raṇe parākramam ।। 5.47.25।।।।

translations.english: The strongarmed Hanuman, who was aware of the propriety of actions, wounded in his arms by the warrior prince started roaring and thinking about the next strategy in the combat.
translations.hindi: तुमने कठोर तप कर जिस धर्मफढ स्वरूप ऐशवयं भौर दीघंकालीन जीवन को पाया है, उसे घर्मविरुद्ध कायं कर नष्ट करना उचित नहीं

verses.sloka: अबालवद्बालदिवाकरप्रभः करोत्ययं कर्म महन्महाबलः ।न चास्य सर्वाहवकर्मशोभिनः प्रमापणे मे मतिरत्र जायते ।। ५.४७.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: abālavadbāladivākaraprabhaḥ karotyayaṁ karma mahanmahābalaḥ ।na cāsya sarvāhavakarmaśobhinaḥ pramāpaṇe me matiratra jāyate ।। 5.47.26।।।।

translations.english: 'He (Aksha) is like the radiant, rising Sun with extraordinary might. He is accomplishing great deeds unlike young warriors of his age and is exhibiting a magnificent feat. He knows all means of fighting. I do not feel like cutting him to size. My mind does not allow me to kill this boy.

verses.sloka: अयं महात्मा च महांश्च वीर्यतः समाहितश्चातिसहश्च संयुगे ।असंशयं कर्मगुणोदयादयं सनागयक्षेर्मुनिभिश्च पूजितः ।। ५.४७.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ mahātmā ca mahāṁśca vīryataḥ samāhitaścātisahaśca saṁyuge ।asaṁśayaṁ karmaguṇodayādayaṁ sanāgayakṣermunibhiśca pūjitaḥ ।। 5.47.27।।।।

translations.english: 'He is a great self. His valour is also admirable. He is focused in battle and highly tolerant. There is no doubt that on account of his excellence even nagas, yakshas and sages offer salutations to him.
translations.hindi: वह यह कि, सुग्रीव न तो देवता हैं, न राक्षस है, न दानव हूँ, न गन्धव हे, न यक्ष हैं प्रौर न पन्नग ही हे

verses.sloka: पराक्रमोत्साहविवृद्धमानसः समीक्षते मां प्रमुखागतः स्थितः ।पराक्रमो ह्यस्य मनांसि कम्पयेत् सुरासुराणामपि शीघ्रगामिनः ।। ५.४७.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: parākramotsāhavivṛddhamānasaḥ samīkṣate māṁ pramukhāgataḥ sthitaḥ ।parākramo hyasya manāṁsi kampayet surāsurāṇāmapi śīghragāminaḥ ।। 5.47.28।।।।

translations.english: 'His mental horizon is enhanced by his valour and power. He is standing before me and dares to look into my eyes. Surely his swift movement and valour will shake even the minds of suras and asuras.
translations.hindi: सो हे राजन ! सुग्रीव से श्राप भ्रपने प्राणों की रक्षा क्यों कर सकेंगे ? यह ठीक है कि, घमं द्वारा श्रधम्‌ का नाश होता है, किन्तु जिनके ग्रघर्म के १ सन्ताप:--तपद्चर्या । विपाक का समय उपस्थित होने वाला है, उसे घर्म का फच ककरी प्राप्त नहीं होता प्रर्थात्‌ तुम्हारे घे से तुम्हारा अधर्म बलवान है । हे राजन्‌ ! धर्मे का फल तो आप निस्सन्देह पा ही चुके हें

verses.sloka: न खल्वयं नाभिभवेदुपेक्षितः पराक्रमो ह्यस्य रणे विवर्धते ।प्रमापणं त्वेव ममास्य रोचते न वर्धमानो ऽग्निरुपेक्षितुं क्षमः ।। ५.४७.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: na khalvayaṁ nābhibhavedupekṣitaḥ parākramo hyasya raṇe vivardhate ।pramāpaṇaṁ tveva mamāsya rocate na vardhamāno 'gnirupekṣituṁ kṣamaḥ ।। 5.47.29।।।।

translations.english: If I ignore him now, he would get the better of me (I have to consider his challenge seriously). His valour in the battle is growing. It is proper to subdue him now. A spreading fire cannot be neglected.

verses.sloka: इति प्रवेगं तु परस्य तर्कयन् स्वकर्मयोगं च विधाय वीर्यवान् ।चकार वेगं तु महाबलस्तदा मतिं च चक्रे ऽस्य वधे महाकपिः ।। ५.४७.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: iti pravegaṁ tu parasya tarkayan svakarmayogaṁ ca vidhāya vīryavān ।cakāra vegaṁ tu mahābalastadā matiṁ ca cakre 'sya vadhe mahākapiḥ ।। 5.47.30।।।।

translations.english: Reflecting on the power of the enemy, the mighty and valiant vanara thought of his own course of action. Hanuman made up his mind to kill the enemy and increased his speed.
translations.hindi: सीताहरणरूपी इस अघम का फल भो तुमको शीघ्र मिलेगा । झब तुम जन- स्थानवासी चौदह हजार राक्षसों के तथा वाल के बघ पर विचार करो तथा श्रीराम घोर सुग्रीव की मेत्रो का स्मरण कर, प्रपना हित जिसमें होता हो सो, विचारो। यदि चाह तो निश्चण मे प्रकेला ही, घोड़ों थोर हाथियों सहित

verses.sloka: स तस्य तानष्ट हयान् महाजवान् समाहितान् भारसहान् विवर्तने ।जघान वीरः पथि वायुसेविते तलप्रहारैः पवनात्मजः कपिः ।। ५.४७.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya tānaṣṭa hayān mahājavān samāhitān bhārasahān vivartane ।jaghāna vīraḥ pathi vāyusevite talaprahāraiḥ pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ ।। 5.47.31।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman the brave son of the Windgod hit with his palm and killed the eight horses (yoked to Aksha's chariot) which had great speed were stable and had the capacity to bear heavy loads while turning round in the sky. (The battle was fought in the air since Hanuman leaped into the air and the demon hero had to resist him there).

verses.sloka: ततस्तलेनाभिहतो महारथः स तस्य पिङ्गाधिपमन्त्रिनिर्जितः ।प्रभग्ननीडः परिमुक्तकूबरः पपात भूमौ हतवाजिरम्बरात् ।। ५.४७.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastalenābhihato mahārathaḥ sa tasya piṅgādhipamantrinirjitaḥ ।prabhagnanīḍaḥ parimuktakūbaraḥ papāta bhūmau hatavājirambarāt ।। 5.47.32।।।।

translations.english: Then hit by Hanuman with his palm, the minister of the copperyeyed Sugriva, the huge chariot seat of Aksha was broken, the wooden frame of the yoke was disjointed, horses were slain and the great chariot fell down from the sky.
translations.hindi: तुम्हारी लंका को नष्ट कर सकता हूं, फर श्रीरामधन्द्रजी ये मुझे ऐसी झाज्ञा नहीं दी-_क्योंकि उन्होंने वानरों प्रौर रीछों के सामने प्रतिदा की है कि,

verses.sloka: स तं परित्यज्य महारथो रथं सकार्मुकः खड्गधरः खमुत्पतन् ।तपोभियोगादृषिरुग्रवीर्यवान् विहाय देहं मरुतामिवालयम् ।। ५.४७.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ parityajya mahāratho rathaṁ sakārmukaḥ khaḍgadharaḥ khamutpatan ।tapobhiyogādṛṣirugravīryavān vihāya dehaṁ marutāmivālayam ।। 5.47.33।।।।

translations.english: (Aksha) the great charioteer abandoned the chariot, held a sword and a bow, and flew up to the region of the sky with his fierce power just as a sage with his fearsome ascetic power ascends to heaven, leaving his body.
translations.hindi: जिसने सोता को हरा है उसको में उच्छिन्न करूंगा घर्थात्‌ नाश करूँगा । फिर यदि इन्द्र ही क्यों न न हो और श्रौरामचन्द्रजी का भ्रपकार करें तो

verses.sloka: ततः कपिस्तं विचरन्तमम्बरे पतत्त्रिराजानिलसिद्धसेविते ।समेत्य तं मारुततुल्यविक्रमः क्रमेण जग्राह स पादयोर्दृढम् ।। ५.४७.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kapistaṁ vicarantamambare patattrirājānilasiddhasevite ।sametya taṁ mārutatulyavikramaḥ krameṇa jagrāha sa pādayordṛḍham ।। 5.47.34।।।।

translations.english: Thereupon Hanuman with the prowess that was equal to wind, approaching the sky firmly caught hold of the legs of Aksha flying into the abode of Garuda, the Windgod and the Siddhas.
translations.hindi: बे कमी भी सुखी नहीं रह सकते । फिर तुम जैसे लोगों की तो बात ही झ्या है हे रावण ! जिसे तुम सीता समझ रहे हो और जो इस समय तुम्हारे पंजे में फंसी हुई है

verses.sloka: स तं समाविध्य सहस्रशः कपिर्महोरगं गृह्य इवाण्डजेश्वरः ।मुमोच वेगात् पितृतुल्यविक्रमो महीतले संयति वानरोत्तमः ।। ५.४७.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ samāvidhya sahasraśaḥ kapirmahoragaṁ gṛhya ivāṇḍajeśvaraḥ ।mumoca vegāt pitṛtulyavikramo mahītale saṁyati vānarottamaḥ ।। 5.47.35।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras who was equal to his father in valour, seized him just as Garuda, the lord of birds, would seize a great serpent. And spinning him round speedily a thousand times and hitting him, dropped him on the earth.
translations.hindi: उसे तुम सारी लंका का नाश करने वाली कालरात्रि समझो । बस, थब तुम सीतारूपी काल की फाँसी को

verses.sloka: स भग्नबाहूरुकटीशिरोधरः क्षसन्नसृङ्निर्मथितास्थिलोचनः ।स भग्रसन्धिः प्रविकीर्णबन्धनो हतः क्षितौ वायुसुतेन राक्षसः ।महाकपिर्भूमितले निपीड्य तं चकार रक्षोधिपतेर्महद्भयम् ।। ५.४७.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa bhagnabāhūrukaṭīśirodharaḥ kṣasannasṛṅnirmathitāsthilocanaḥ ।sa bhagrasandhiḥ pravikīrṇabandhano hataḥ kṣitau vāyusutena rākṣasaḥ ।mahākapirbhūmitale nipīḍya taṁ cakāra rakṣodhipatermahadbhayam ।। 5.47.36।।।।

translations.english: Hit by Hanuman, the ogre's arms, thighs, hips and neck broken, bones rendered to fragments, eyes protruded, joints disjointed, tendons strewn he was thrown down on the earth dripping blood.

verses.sloka: महर्षिभिश्चक्रचरैर्महाव्रतैः समेत्य भूतैश्च सयक्षपन्नगैः ।सुरैश्च सैन्द्रैर्भृशजातविस्मयैर्हते कुमारे स कपिर्निरीक्षितः ।। ५.४७.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: maharṣibhiścakracarairmahāvrataiḥ sametya bhūtaiśca sayakṣapannagaiḥ ।suraiśca saindrairbhṛśajātavismayairhate kumāre sa kapirnirīkṣitaḥ ।। 5.47.37।।।।

translations.english: When the great vanara dashed Aksha down on to the earth, the king of demons was struck with terror. The great sages who go round the planets, great seers who were observants of vows, yakshas, panagas, suras including Indra all beings collected together and looked at the vanara with awe.
translations.hindi: बह्यमानाभिमां पश्य पुरीं साट्टप्रतोलिकास । स्वानि सित्राणि मन्त्रश्च ज्ञातीन्श्रातुन्म्रुतान्हितान्‌ ।। ३७७ पीड़ित हो, तुम इस का को श्रटा अटारियो सहित भस्म हुई समझो । प्रतः तुम ग्रपने मित्रो, मंत्रियों, जाति-बिरादरी, भाइयों, पुत्रों प्रौर हितषियों को

verses.sloka: निहत्य तं वज्रिसुतोपमप्रभं कुमारमक्षं क्षतजोपमेक्षणम् ।तमेव वीरो ऽभिजगाम तोरणं कृतक्षणः काल इव प्रजाक्षये ।। ५.४७.३८।।
verses.transliteration: nihatya taṁ vajrisutopamaprabhaṁ kumāramakṣaṁ kṣatajopamekṣaṇam ।tameva vīro 'bhijagāma toraṇaṁ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye ।। 5.47.38।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the hero with bloodshot eyes having slain Aksha, shone resplendent like the son of Indra (Jayanta), and reached the portal, and waited looking like the god of death determined to destroy all beings. इत्यार्षे वाल्मीकीये श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
